about: One-shot head motions played on top of whatever the face is doing.
Each key is an offset from where the face is pointing, in ROS REP-103 degrees:
yaw   + turns to the device's own left (the viewer's right)
pitch + nods down (the tilt servo stops at about +18 down from level)
roll  + top of the head toward the device's own right; drawn on the screen only
Missing axes are 0. 't' is ms from the start; the first key is t=0 at 0 and the last key is back at 0.
'ease' (smooth | snappy | spring) shapes the segment that ends at that key; default smooth.
'expression' optionally borrows an expression's eyes during the action: eased in over in_ms,
given back at until_ms over out_ms. The head motion always comes from the keys.
The servos follow what they can; whatever they cannot (speed, limits) the screen draws.
Edit, then idf.py build: scripts/actions2c.py checks everything and warns about fast motion.

actions.name: shake
actions.description: Shakes the head: no, disagree, not that.

actions.name: look_around
actions.description: Looks to one side, then the other, as if checking the surroundings.

actions.name: doze
actions.description: Nods off: the head slowly droops with drowsy eyes, then jerks awake.

actions.name: tilt
actions.description: Tilts the head to one side, curious or puzzled.

actions.name: bow
actions.description: Bows politely: a slow, deep nod with the eyes closed.

actions.name: startle
actions.description: Startles: jerks back with wide-open eyes, then settles.

actions.name: perk_up
actions.description: Perks up: lifts the head alertly, as if something caught its attention.

actions.name: bounce
actions.description: Bounces with excitement: quick little hops, for joy or celebration.

actions.name: turn_away
actions.description: Turns away shyly with a downcast look, then slowly comes back.

actions.name: jiggle
actions.description: Jiggles side to side in two short bursts to get attention, like a notification.

actions.name: sigh
actions.description: Sighs: a small lift, then the head sinks slowly with tired eyes and comes back.
